supersededGapJob.method: A guarded compression-only retry reused completed facts, experiences, summaries and embeddings. Owner/source fences and Workflow retry identity were retained; no task was manually marked complete.

liveRecovery.unitDefinition: Observed units include Unicode fragments of long events or structured records; they are not unique-event counts.

characterViews.note: This operational case had no qualifying source fragments for the selected character view. Its summaries stayed empty; positive grants and knowledge cases are covered by deterministic tests.

failuresAndRepairs: A historical factual gap and concurrent projection commits prevented contiguous coverage. Replayed validated artifacts, retained source fences and added bounded re-preparation after atomic CAS rollback.
Empty buckets repeatedly scanned unrelated memory history. Bucket/status and requested-key filters now run in SQL before expansion.
Publishing only after all pages left completed narrative prefixes unavailable. Each successful page now publishes its complete-event prefix; partial events do not advance it.

A strict 1000-token target rejected valid summaries and nested retries repeated the same repair group. The target is now soft, the 1800-token safety limit remains enforced, and exhausted semantic repair is non-retryable.
